name: No Witnesses
oracle_text: Each player who controls the most creatures investigates. Then destroy all creatures. (To investigate, create a Clue token. It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")
flavor_text: When cunning fails, there's always violence.

name: Aggravate
oracle_text: Aggravate deals 1 damage to each creature target player controls. Each creature dealt damage this way attacks this turn if able.
flavor_text:
"Barbarians! They burned my favorite chair! We'll kill them all!"
—Anje Falkenrath

name: When We Were Young
oracle_text: Up to two target creatures each get +2/+2 until end of turn. If you control an artifact and an enchantment, those creatures also gain lifelink until end of turn.
flavor_text: Since Imperial custom strictly forbade the Emperor to reveal her name—even to Kaito, her closest childhood friend—she had to suffer him calling her "your emperorness" for much of their shared youth.

name: Epicenter
oracle_text:
Target player sacrifices a land of their choice.
Threshold — Each player sacrifices all lands they control instead if there are seven or more cards in your graveyard.
flavor_text: Sometimes destruction is Dominaria's way of rebuilding. Sometimes it's not.

name: Come Back Wrong
oracle_text: Destroy target creature. If a creature card is put into a graveyard this way, return it to the battlefield under your control. Sacrifice it at the beginning of your next end step.
flavor_text:
"See?! That's why you always burn the bodies."
—Rip, spawn hunter

name: Fraying Omnipotence
oracle_text: Each player loses half their life, then discards half the cards in their hand, then sacrifices half the creatures they control of their choice. Round up each time.
flavor_text: The Great Mending that healed the Multiverse also unraveled the threads of Nicol Bolas's power.

name: Dazzling Reflection
oracle_text: You gain life equal to target creature's power. The next time that creature would deal damage this turn, prevent that damage.
flavor_text:
"The light of a felidar's horns can give even an Eldrazi pause."
—Zarra, lullmage

name: Malamet Battle Glyph
oracle_text: Choose target creature you control and target creature you don't control. If the creature you control entered this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on it. Then those creatures fight each other.
flavor_text:
"Let's not give the surface-dwellers time to learn what tactics work best here."
—Daram, Malamet marshal

name: Volcanic Eruption
oracle_text: Destroy X target Mountains. Volcanic Eruption deals damage to each creature and each player equal to the number of Mountains put into a graveyard this way.

name: Omen of Fire
oracle_text: Return all Islands to their owners' hands. Each player sacrifices a Plains or a white permanent of their choice for each white permanent they control.
flavor_text:
"Let Balduvia burn to warm Kjeldor's hearth!"
—General Varchild

name: Spiteful Repossession
oracle_text: Spiteful Repossession deals damage to each opponent who controls more lands than you equal to the difference. Then create a number of Treasure tokens equal to the damage dealt this way.
flavor_text: Late payment shall be extracted however they see fit.

name: Brightflame
oracle_text: Radiance — Brightflame deals X damage to target creature and each other creature that shares a color with it. You gain life equal to the damage dealt this way.
flavor_text:
"Let the pyres of the unbelievers light our way."
—Razia

name: Ent's Fury
oracle_text: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control if its power is 4 or greater. Then that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn and fights target creature you don't control.
set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
flavor_text:
"I came and called the trees by their long names, but they did not hear or answer—they lay dead."
—Quickbeam

name: Stronghold Gambit
oracle_text: Each player chooses a card in their hand. Then each player reveals their chosen card. The owner of each creature card revealed this way with the lowest mana value puts it onto the battlefield.

name: Rhystic Scrying
oracle_text: Draw three cards. Then if any player pays {2}, discard three cards.
flavor_text:
"The trick is to ask when no one's listening."
—Alexi, zephyr mage

name: Builder's Bane
oracle_text: Destroy X target artifacts. Builder's Bane deals damage to each player equal to the number of artifacts they controlled that were put into a graveyard this way.
flavor_text: There is only so much a person may be buried with.

name: Kamahl's Summons
oracle_text: Each player may reveal any number of creature cards from their hand. Then each player creates a 2/2 green Bear creature token for each card they revealed this way.
flavor_text: As Krosa unleashed the peace in Kamahl, he unleashed the fury in Krosa.

name: Send to Sleep
oracle_text:
Tap up to two target creatures.
Spell mastery — If there are two or more instant and/or sorcery cards in your graveyard, those creatures don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps.

name: Breaking Point
oracle_text: Any player may have Breaking Point deal 6 damage to them. If no one does, destroy all creatures. Creatures destroyed this way can't be regenerated.
flavor_text: "Enough!"

name: Sink into Takenuma
oracle_text: Sweep — Return any number of Swamps you control to their owner's hand. Target player discards a card for each Swamp returned this way.

name: Ego Drain
oracle_text: Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose a nonland card from it. That player discards that card. If you don't control a Faerie, exile a card from your hand.
flavor_text: "You've wasted your life. Let's see if I can do any better with it."

name: Savage Swipe
oracle_text: Target creature you control gets +2/+2 until end of turn if its power is 2. Then it fights target creature you don't control. (Each deals damage equal to its power to the other.)
flavor_text: Nine generations of metalworking skill are no match for nine hundred pounds of rage.

name: Charge Across the Araba
oracle_text: Sweep — Return any number of Plains you control to their owner's hand. Creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn for each Plains returned this way.

name: Alpha Brawl
oracle_text: Target creature an opponent controls deals damage equal to its power to each other creature that player controls, then each of those creatures deals damage equal to its power to that creature.
flavor_text: Being an alpha means proving it every full moon.

name: Friendly Fire
oracle_text: Target creature's controller reveals a card at random from their hand. Friendly Fire deals damage to that creature and that player equal to the revealed card's mana value.
flavor_text:
"Never tell goblins to 'fire at will.'"
—Urut Barzeel, Mardu hordechief

name: Throw from the Saddle
oracle_text: Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on it instead if it's a Mount. Then it deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.
flavor_text:
"A little kindness would've carried you a lot farther than those spurs."
—Miriam, herd whisperer

name: Urborg Justice
oracle_text: Target opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice for each creature put into your graveyard from the battlefield this turn.
flavor_text:
"It is a narrow line between justice and vengeance."
—Crovax

name: Barrel Down Sokenzan
oracle_text: Sweep — Return any number of Mountains you control to their owner's hand. Barrel Down Sokenzan deals damage to target creature equal to twice the number of Mountains returned this way.

name: Covetous Elegy
oracle_text: Each player chooses up to two creatures they control, then sacrifices the rest. Then you create a tapped Treasure token for each creature your opponents control.
flavor_text: Wealthier than ever thanks to exorbitant interest on wartime loans, the Orzhov only grew hungrier for more.

name: Plow Through Reito
oracle_text: Sweep — Return any number of Plains you control to their owner's hand. Target creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn for each Plains returned this way.
flavor_text: The paths of the kami crisscrossed Kamigawa like scars left by a maddened surgeon.

name: Friendly Rivalry
oracle_text: Target creature you control and up to one other target legendary creature you control each deal damage equal to their power to target creature you don't control.
set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
flavor_text:
"Forty-two, Master Legolas!"
—Gimli

name: Brood Birthing
oracle_text: If you control an Eldrazi Spawn, create three 0/1 colorless Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens. They have "Sacrifice this token: Add {C}." Otherwise, create one of those tokens.

name: Tandem Takedown
oracle_text: Up to two target creatures you control each get +1/+0 until end of turn. They each deal damage equal to their power to another target creature, planeswalker, or battle.
flavor_text:
"I take no pleasure in this, but Vadrok might."
—Vivien Reid, to Lukka

name: Essence Vortex
oracle_text: Destroy target creature unless its controller pays life equal to its toughness. A creature destroyed this way can't be regenerated.
flavor_text: Masters who sacrifice for servants will receive the gift of loyalty.

name: Underworld Fires
oracle_text: Underworld Fires deals 1 damage to each creature and each planeswalker. If a permanent dealt damage this way would die this turn, exile it instead.
flavor_text: The Underworld is anything but a resting place.

name: Pulse of the Forge
oracle_text: Pulse of the Forge deals 4 damage to target player or planeswalker. Then if that player or that planeswalker's controller has more life than you, return Pulse of the Forge to its owner's hand.
flavor_text: Before wars or weapons, there was anger.

name: Icy Blast
oracle_text:
Tap X target creatures.
Ferocious — If you control a creature with power 4 or greater, those creatures don't untap during their controllers' next untap steps.
flavor_text: "Do not think the sand or the sun will hold back the breath of winter."

name: Rhystic Lightning
oracle_text: Rhystic Lightning deals 4 damage to any target unless that permanent's controller or that player pays {2}. If they do, Rhystic Lightning deals 2 damage to the permanent or player.

name: Dose of Dawnglow
oracle_text: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Then if it isn't your main phase, blight 2. (Put two -1/-1 counters on a creature you control.)
flavor_text: A lifetime of mischief gave way to a moment of tenderness.

name: Dead Ringers
oracle_text: Destroy two target nonblack creatures unless either one is a color the other isn't. They can't be regenerated.
flavor_text: "Beautiful, isn't it?" crowed Crovax. "They fought together. Now they will die together."
